parsed.post: Significant improvement found by increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6. val_bpb dropped from 1.099770 to 1.067257. Now exploring the interaction between depth and learning rate. I will try adding a small WARMUP_RATIO to see if we can push the MATRIX_LR even higher without instability.
parsed.description: Increase depth to 6 and introduce a 5% warmup ratio to stabilize potentially higher learning rates.
